description: This file defines a data model and repository layer for notes within a Notes API. It includes a Note dataclass with various fields and a NotesRepository class that manages in-memory storage and operations like create, retrieve, update, delete, and search on notes.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Domain model representing a Note with fields such as id, title, content, tags, timestamps, and archived status. Includes a method to update its fields.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: In-memory repository for performing CRUD operations and searches on Note instances.

methods.name: None update_from(self, title: Optional[str] = None, content: Optional[str] = None, tags: Optional[List[str]] = None, archived: Optional[bool] = None)
methods.description: Method in Note class to update mutable fields and refresh the updated_at timestamp.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Constructor initializing in-memory storage for notes.

methods.name: int _next_id(self)
methods.description: Generates the next unique identifier for a new note.

methods.name: List[Note] list(self, *, q: Optional[str] = None, tag: Optional[str] = None, archived: Optional[bool] = None)
methods.description: Returns a list of notes, optionally filtered by search query, tag, or archived status.

methods.name: Optional[Note] get(self, note_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID.

methods.name: Note create(self, title: str, content: str, tags: Optional[List[str]] = None)
methods.description: Creates a new note with specified title, content, and optional tags.

methods.name: Optional[Note] update(self, note_id: int, *, title: Optional[str] = None, content: Optional[str] = None, tags: Optional[List[str]] = None, archived: Optional[bool] = None)
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with new values.

methods.name: bool delete(self, note_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.

ctags.name: create
ctags.pattern: /^    def create(self, title: str, content: str, tags: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> Note:$/
ctags.signature: (self, title: str, content: str, tags: Optional[List[str]] = None)

ctags.name: list
ctags.pattern: /^    def list(self, *, q: Optional[str] = None, tag: Optional[str] = None,$/
ctags.signature: (self, *, q: Optional[str] = None, tag: Optional[str] = None, archived: Optional[bool] = None)

ctags.name: update
ctags.pattern: /^    def update(self, note_id: int, *, title: Optional[str] = None, content: Optional[str] = None/
ctags.signature: (self, note_id: int, *, title: Optional[str] = None, content: Optional[str] = None, tags: Optional[List[str]] = None, archived: Optional[bool] = None)

ctags.name: update_from
ctags.pattern: /^    def update_from(self, title: Optional[str] = None, content: Optional[str] = None,$/
ctags.signature: (self, title: Optional[str] = None, content: Optional[str] = None, tags: Optional[List[str]] = None, archived: Optional[bool] = None)
